name: orin-whisper-c64
description: Copy of orin-whisper with the admission ceiling raised from 8 to 64, for the orin-nano (J3011) / orin-nx (J4012) Whisper concurrency-ceiling sweep (bench/asr_bench/DISPATCH.md). Same backend/build (base, bf16 TensorRT encoder, ONNX decoder with KV cache) — this only changes how many callers may queue instead of taking a 429.
